text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed every six months as 
indicated by M6 or after 1000 operating hours in the above titled block. 
This device used for
slowly
motion.
The first draft is initiated by eng. Saad Samra, tested by eng. Mohamed 
 Abdel Azeem at 07 July 2003 , accepted by eng. Mohamed Elasrrag General 
 Manager, revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abouda El-Bana, and 
 approved by eng. Moneer Mahmoud El Wakeel Damietta CCPS Head Sector
Technical Specifications
Manufacturer | Siemens.
Test Medium | Turbine oil TD46.
Test pressure | 9 bars.
Temperature | 50 C.
Tripping force at pawl | 42 N.
Oil flow in operating position | 0.0003 dm3.
Over travel for latching | 2-+0.2
Safety Precautions
Issue work order including the teamwork names.
Use Safety fences (ropes) with caution marks to surround the work area.
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Tools and Equipment
Complete set of tools.
Grease gun
Soft brush, Oil can.
Cleaning articles.
Work to be Carried Out
Lubricate movable parts. (The type 
 of oil is VG46).
Check the oil level; add if it is 
 required.
